scope: First batch refinement, using the completed second batch as a versioned reference
rules: Preserve hero identity and original source text for history; gameplay adaptations may simplify original fidelity.
Use existing enabled templates, effect kinds, hooks and conditions. Do not add engine features, template definitions or global status labels.
Humor must change the player's decisions or combo outcomes; cosmetic renaming alone is not a distinct signature.
Each hero needs a distinct core combo, a role and an actionable counter. Do not add unrelated abilities merely to improve diversity counts.
Reuse shipped curse, blind and confusion behavior; instance-local resources must remain isolated between heroes and versions.
A previous similar-loop exception is not automatic approval under this policy.
Only validated content enters the accepted evaluation set; compilation, asset presence and structural uniqueness are separate diagnostics.
Keep template, generator, hero and model version history. No shared-instance edits or silent replacement.
tanjiroAdaptation: Water and fire share a one-breath Q. Fire trades movement speed for damage; EX cannot reset cooldown or remove burden. The unpushed conditional-cost engine extension is withdrawn.
